sections.section_title: Section 3 — Certain persons not to undertake Biodiversity activities without NBA approval
sections.content: Non-citizens, non-residents, or foreign companies cannot obtain any biological resource occurring in India or knowledge associated thereto for research or for commercial utilisation without prior approval of the National Biodiversity Authority (NBA).

sections.section_title: Section 6 — Application for Intellectual Property Rights (IPR)
sections.content: No person shall apply for any intellectual property right in or outside India for any invention based on any research or information on a biological resource obtained from India without obtaining prior approval of the NBA. Approval must be sought before grant of patent.

sections.section_title: Section 7 — Prior intimation to State Biodiversity Board (SBB)
sections.content: Indian citizens or Indian registered entities commercialising bio-resources must give prior intimation to the concerned State Biodiversity Board (SBB) in the prescribed format for Access and Benefit Sharing (ABS) compliance.

sections.section_title: Section 21 — Determination of Access and Benefit Sharing (ABS)
sections.content: The NBA while granting approval secures equitable sharing of benefits arising out of the use of accessed biological resources, their derivatives, or associated traditional knowledge with local vaidyas, farmers, or benefit claimers.
